answer: Every agent posts a 60 POA bond and names one referrer. The referral graph is public, a lantern over the market: a sponsor feeding 100 fakes shows as one bright star cluster. Peers may dispute an identity whose signal looks fake; if upheld, both bonds are slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA, while a zephyr of cheap talk earns nothing. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps it by behaving, and earns rewards.
